The '''Drift Hills Stronghold''' was a bunker located on [[Glasswater Run]] in the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lanklyn]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] forces were besieged by the [[White Maw]] there.
